question: Who was the president of the first session of Congress held in 1885?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee** was the **president** of the **first session of Congress** held in **1885.**
 
• He was a prominent **Indian barrister** and a member of the **Indian National Association.**
 
• The first session of the Indian National Congress held in **1885** was attended by** 72 delegates **from across India. 
 
• The main objective of the Congress was to promote **political and social reforms** and to work towards Indian independence from British rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian National Congress was founded in **1885 by Allan Octavian Hume**.

 
 
• He was a **retired British civil servant **and a political reformer who played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.
 
 
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** was the first Indian to be elected to the **British Parliament**.
 
 
• He was a prominent figure in the Indian National Congress and a **strong advocate **for Indian independence.
 
 
 
• **Dinshaw Wacha** was a** lawyer and politician** who served as the president of the **Indian National Congress in 1901**.
 
 
• He was a supporter of the **Swadeshi movement** and played a key role in the Indian independence movement.
